notes.title: New Version Testing Plan!
notes.notes:
Dear players, hello! We are delighted to communicate with you once again.

Currently, based on players' feedback, we have continuously updated and modified the game content, and we will continue to optimize the game.

During the May Day holiday, the Fairyland Adventure Map will soon launch a brand new version for testing!

We hereby invite 100 players to experience the new characters. This testing phase will last until May 7th. If you encounter any issues or bugs during gameplay, please provide feedback to our email(Feedback email: 1392064799@qq.com).

Thank you very much for your participation and support!

Wishing you a pleasant gaming experience!

Best regards

notes.title: V0.7.5 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Based on your feedback, we have conducted an optimization of the current version. The key improvements are as follows:

Added a 2x speed feature, allowing NPCs to move more swiftly.
Adjusted the movement mechanics of talismans. Now, the movable range is displayed only upon selecting a talisman.
Fixed several known bugs, enhancing game stability and smoothness.
We value your opinions and suggestions greatly. Please feel free to provide feedback through our forum or Q-group. We are eager to hear from you and continuously improve the gaming experience.

Thank you once again for your support and participation!

Wishing you an enjoyable gaming experience!

Best regards,
Game Development Team
